## What this project is

It’s a local Python study planner for PN/RPN learners. You enter short tags for missed topics; it builds a seven day plan and editable journal, with optional study streaks, a local leaderboard, and JSON output. It gives study prompts, not clinical answers. See the [README](README.md:1).

## Rules that apply

- Use your own brief topic tags and observations. Do not copy or paraphrase paid question bank questions, answers, or rationales into inputs or notes. The program cannot verify the origin of free text. [README](README.md:87)
- Check clinical details and RPN scope against current course materials and local guidance. The nursing review and wording tests are not clinical validation. [README](README.md:66)
- Keep personal study files local. Git ignores the seed, journals, study log, leaderboard, and teammate note; I confirmed none appears in the tracked history. [.gitignore](.gitignore:4)
